deadline.value: Apply by February 1, 2027 as an international applicant (US applicants March 1).

gre_general.value: GRE scores are part of the PhD application; the department prefers a combined V+Q score of 315.
gre_general.quote: Application material should include: Online application, GRE scores, TOEFL scores (international applicants)

also.quote: The combined (V&Q) GRE score preferred for admission is 315.

toefl_min.quote: The minimum TOEFL score is 83 (IBT) or 7 (IELTS).

ielts_min.quote: The minimum TOEFL score is 83 (IBT) or 7 (IELTS).

english_waiver.value: TOEFL is not required with a bachelor's or advanced degree from a recognized program in a country where the official language of instruction is English; India is not named, so ask the department whether your degree qualifies.
english_waiver.quote: TOEFL is not required if you have a bachelor or advanced degree from an accredited US program or if you have a bachelor or advanced degree from a recognized program in a country where the official language of instruction is English.

supervisor.value: PhD applicants should discuss research areas and potential faculty advisors in the personal statement.
supervisor.quote: PhD and research-oriented MS applicants should also discuss areas of research and potential faculty advisors they are interested in working with.
